component.name: BearWave
component.summary: Desktop internet radio app for Linux

description.p: BearWave is a Qt 6 desktop internet radio player for fast station browsing, simple playback controls, favorites, resume support, and tray behavior without turning into a heavy media suite.
This community package installs BearWave's unmodified official Linux release from GitHub at install time.

ul.li: Internet radio via Radio Browser with local JSON caching
Favorites and manually added streams with local persistence
Now Playing artwork, track metadata, MPRIS, tray integration, and notifications
German, Dutch, and Russian translations with localized country names

screenshot.caption: Main window with station list, details, and player controls
World browser with localized country names
About dialog with language selection and release notes

ul.li: Initial FlatPark package using the official BearWave Linux runtime payload
